hero.title: Burgers, dogs *and root beer floats*
hero.lede: Locally owned and operated since 1964. Hand-pattied burgers from Lanier’s Meat Market, all-beef dogs on Masada Bakery buns, Kyle’s chili, soft serve and the famous Sno-Cap root beer float.

sections.title: A trip down *memory lane*
body: Sno-Cap has been locally owned and operated on West Avenue since 1964. We’re proud of our town and our history, and we want to share that with everyone who stops by.
Whether you stop in to split one of our famous root beer floats or share a family meal, we’re happy to serve you.
list: Buns baked locally by Masada Bakery

sections.title: Drop-off *catering*
sections.intro: Burger-in-a-Box or the Burger Bar, dropped off in disposable aluminum or plastic containers.

items.title: Ask for a quote
items.text: Send the date, time, address, head count and the menu you’d like.

items.title: Hear back fast
items.text: Quotes go out within 12 to 24 hours, often sooner.

items.title: Give a little notice
items.text: Please allow 24 to 48 hours for weekend orders.

items.title: We drop it off
items.text: Catering runs 10:30 am to 2:30 pm on weekdays. After hours and on weekends, the minimum is 20 people.

items.a: Fries and a drink, for $3.75 on top of anything on the menu.
Yes. Order online for pickup, or call (803) 279-4004.

items.q: What’s in the root beer float?
items.a: Local Red Hare root beer and vanilla soft serve in a frosty mug, for $4.00.

items.q: Do you have a kids menu?
items.a: Yes: a short hot dog, 4 oz hamburger, grilled cheese, chicken tenders or a corn dog, with smiley fries and a drink, for $6.50.
Monday to Saturday, 10:30 am to 9:00 pm.

sections.title: Float o’clock?
sections.text: Open Monday to Saturday until 9 on West Avenue.
